title: Trip lookup: closed trip ended before the identification (part 1 of 2, first trip)
description: Part 1 of 2 for O12c, played in order against the same asset (part1 then part2). This trip runs and closes with no identifications of its own; it exists only to establish a first, closed trip on the asset before part 2 introduces both a second trip and the identification that must land in the gap between them.
